name: BloodRivals
summary:
BloodRivals is a location-based multiplayer strategy game played on a map of the player's real city. Players walk to real buildings to claim them, build them up into shops that earn coins or gyms that train fighters, and work with their team to hold their streets against rival teams who can attack and take them over.

Nothing on the map is held for good. Coins left uncollected on a roof go to whoever takes the house, attacks travel across the map so a defender gets a warning, and teammates can defend a house together. Each player can also raise a BloodFighter, a champion steered around the map who guards the buildings around him. A player's score is their total net worth, and the game runs in named periods called reigns, with the top players and teams crowned when each one ends.
